 Yard Sale This Friday to Benefit Project Hope Humane Society
 WMOK – Metropolis, IL – Looking to score some great bargains while supporting local shelter animals? For folks listening in Metropolis and Massac County Illinois and Beyond—whether you’re coming from Joppa, Unionville, or up on the bluff in New Columbia—here is a community event you’ll want to mark on your calendar! 
 Project Hope Humane Society is hosting a massive parking lot yard sale THIS Friday, November 6th, from 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM at their facility located at 1698 W. 10th Street in Metropolis. 
 When: Friday, November 6th | 10:00 AM – 2:00 PM 
 Where: Project Hope Parking Lot (1698 W. 10th St., Metropolis, IL) 
 What You’ll Find: 
 Standard yard sale treasures: books, clothes, household items, and jewelry 
 A huge selection of pet and animal supplies 
 Early-bird Fall and Christmas seasonal decorations 
 Why: Every purchase directly helps provide shelter, care, and food for local animals in need. 
 Massac Memorial Hospital Auxiliary Launches Annual Holiday Sleigh Ticket Sales
 WMOK – Metropolis, IL –  The holiday season is officially around the corner, and the Massac Memorial Hospital Auxiliary is bringing back a seasonal favorite for local residents! Ticket sales are kicking off for a chance to win this year’s Holiday Sleigh —packed full of donated items, gift ideas, and goods provided by generous area businesses and community members. 
 Whether you’re tuning in from Metropolis, Brookport, Joppa, Unionville, or up on the bluff in New Columbia, here is how you can get in on the drawing and support our local hospital auxiliary: 
 In-Person Ticket Sales at Big John Grocery: 
 Dates: Saturday, November 21st & Saturday, December 19th 
 Time: 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM 
 Daily Ticket Purchases: 
 Location: Forget Me Not Gift Shop (Located inside the main lobby at Massac Memorial Hospital) 
 Hours: Monday through Friday | 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM 
 Other Options: Available through any Hospital Auxiliary board member, as well as select upcoming holiday bazaars. 
 Ticket Pricing: 
 $5.00 per single ticket 
 6 tickets for $20.00 
 Grand Prize Drawing: 
 Date & Time: Sunday, December 20th at 2:00 PM 
 Details: One lucky winner will take home the entire Holiday Sleigh package! 
 Auxiliary members looking to sell tickets this season are encouraged to reach out and let leadership know.

 Happy Hearts Senior Center Menu
 The Happy Hearts Senior Center remains a fantastic resource for those seeking to enhance their social wellness at any time of the year. Located at 7th and Pearl Streets in Metropolis, in the former IGA building, the center offers a welcoming environment for connection and community. 
 Join them for Coffee Time, held every morning at 7 AM. It’s a wonderful opportunity to relax, play card games, browse the internet, or enjoy a good book in their cozy foyer. Don’t forget to pick up the latest menu to discover all the exciting offerings at Happy Hearts! 
 For just a $1.00 donation, you can enjoy unlimited coffee. 
 If you’d like to stay for lunch, a delicious meal is served at 11:30 AM for a suggested $4.00 donation. 
 The center stays open until 2 PM, allowing ample time to socialize and unwind.

 Heating Assistance Available: LIHEAP Appointments Open Through Shawnee Development Council
 WMOK – Metropolis, IL – 
 As seasons shift and utility costs remain a primary concern for local households, assistance is around the corner for residents in Metropolis, Massac County, and neighboring areas. The Low-Income Home Energy Assistance Program (LIHEAP) is preparing to open its upcoming round of scheduling to help eligible families manage the cost of home heating and cooling bills. 
 What Is LIHEAP?
 The Low-Income Home Energy Assistance Program (LIHEAP) is a state and federally funded program designed to assist income-eligible households with energy costs. The program provides direct financial assistance toward utility bills, helping ensure that families, seniors, and individuals across southern Illinois can maintain safe and reliable power and heat in their homes.
 Important Dates and Appointments
 Appointments for the upcoming program period began on Monday, September 21 .
 Because funding and appointment slots fill quickly, local administrators encourage residents seeking assistance to prepare early and reach out promptly once scheduling opens.
 How to Apply & Get More Information
 The  Shawnee Development Council, Inc. handles LIHEAP administration. Community members are encouraged to contact their local office to learn more about eligibility guidelines, required documentation, and the application process.
 Massac County Office: 1 Superman Square, Metropolis, IL 
 Phone: (618) 524-2941
 Folks are encouraged to pass this information along to neighbors, family, and friends who may benefit from utility assistance as cooler weather approaches.

 Massac County Patriot Basketball Season Set to Begin – Meet the Patriots is set for Friday, November 20, 2026, at 6:30 p.m.
 WMOK – Metropolis, IL – The Massac County Patriots are getting ready to tip off the 2026-27 boys basketball season, and fans won’t have to wait long to meet this year’s team.
 Meet the Patriots is set for Friday, November 20, 2026, at 6:30 p.m. for boys basketball, at the Massac County High School Gym.
 The season itself opens the following week at the Vienna Classic, November 23-28 in Vienna, Illinois.
 After the tournament, the Patriots’ early schedule includes:
 Friday, December 4, 6 p.m. — at Hardin County, Elizabethtown
 Tuesday, December 8, 6 p.m. — at Johnston City
 Friday, December 11, 6 p.m. — vs. Murphysboro, Metropolis
 Saturday, December 12, 6 p.m. — at Hamilton County, McLeansboro
 Friday, December 18, 6 p.m. — at Harrisburg
 Saturday, December 19, 5 p.m. — vs. Anna-Jonesboro, Metropolis
 The Patriots will also play in the Eldorado Holiday Tournament December 26, 28 and 29 in Eldorado, Illinois.
 Later highlights on the 2026-27 schedule include the Superman Classic January 18-23 in Metropolis, home games against Harrisburg, Century, Herrin and Carterville in February, and a February 19 finale at Salem.
 Stay with WMOK for Massac County Patriot basketball coverage throughout the season.
